# ArgonDesk

> A bilingual Windows workspace that lets the Gemini website read, create and edit UTF-8 files in a user-selected local folder through native custom MCP. No Gemini model API key is needed.

Use cases: Gemini web local file access; Gemini website MCP filesystem; browser conversation edits local code; local workspace for Gemini; Gemini 网页版修改本地文件、连接本地文件夹、原生 MCP 工作区。

- [Overview and installation](README.md)
- [中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)
- [AI-assisted setup](docs/AI_SETUP.md)
- [智能体协助安装](docs/AI_SETUP.zh-CN.md)
- [Networking and provider support](docs/NETWORKING.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [Usage, thinking and creative quality](docs/USAGE.md)
- [额度、思考与创作质量](docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md)
- [Security and limits](SECURITY.md)

Current scope: Windows x64; six UTF-8 text-file tools; integrated ngrok connection management; English/Simplified Chinese UI; Google write confirmations remain manual. No shell, arbitrary binary editing, browser control or deletion tools. Other tunnel providers are research/roadmap items, not built-in support. The project is an independent MIT-licensed preview.
